title: Extract imports and match signals against them in kbfacts
goal: kbfacts has an imports reader per format (Python ast in-process on source text with a size cap, package.json, go.mod, csproj/Directory.Packages.props via xml.etree, PowerShell #Requires and .psd1 RequiredModules via regex) and topics_for(imports=True) matches signals only against those names, skipping generated or vendored files by .gitattributes; tests named import_topics with planted fixtures prove each reader and the comment-only case.
